metadata.title: Degarelix Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain explicitly unassessed and never block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP and product-specific review; no clinical authorisation implied.

source_discrepancies: PDF footer says 12 weeks; treatment text/table clearly specifies 28-day maintenance. Treatment text and table govern encoding.
EMA includes radiotherapy indications beyond NCCP 00481a; they are not silently added to this service.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by the appropriately qualified Consultant specified in the NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification or non-standard continuation should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00481 Version 3. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

action.message: Confirm dates: 240 mg loading as two 120 mg SC injections; first 80 mg maintenance 28 days later, then every 28 days. The PDF footer saying 12 weeks is inconsistent with its treatment section.

source.scope_note: Implementation safety guard based on the cited exclusion, dosing or warning; not a verbatim NCCP numeric threshold.

rules.explanation: Confirm dates: 240 mg loading as two 120 mg SC injections; first 80 mg maintenance 28 days later, then every 28 days. The PDF footer saying 12 weeks is inconsistent with its treatment section.

administration.dose: 240 mg as two consecutive 120 mg SC injections

administration.schedule: First maintenance 28 days later, then every 28 days

treatment.duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.schedule_summary: The first dose is 240 mg as two 120 mg injections under the skin. The first 80 mg maintenance injection is 28 days later, then 80 mg every 28 days. The team sets the total duration.
treatment.duration_text: Individual duration according to disease setting and treatment plan

regular: blood glucose and bone profile as clinically indicated

supportive_care.other: Calcium and vitamin D supplementation according to local policy.

indications.description: Treatment of adult male patients with advanced hormone-dependent prostate cancer.
